company.name: Kem App
company.shortDescription: Kem is the fastest growing payments app in Kuwait & the GCC. Offering instant payment, crypto cards, savings, and more.
company.description:
Kem was started with the idea of achieving a simple goal, to make it easy to send money to your friends. Millions of people in the Gulf were facing this issue, and we built Kem for the purpose of removing the pain from peer-to-peer payments.

Today, Kem is the fastest growing payments app in Kuwait & the GCC. Pay anyone instantly, receive everywhere, spend anywhere. Join the thousands already using the Kem app.

The Kem App is a financial services platform, not a bank. Banking services are provided by Kem’s bank partner(s). Kem Company for Electronic Payment & Settlement Systems W.L.L is a service of Kem Technologies Holding Ltd.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,000,000, or 75% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,812,969 to $20,784,331, a 2.36x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 69 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
